title: Normal Hessian blocks, an exact four-body index jump, and stability obstructions
exact_target: Find sharp Morse-index bounds for central configurations and determine their relation to stability of rigid rotations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002554 (AIM-PHYSICS-0062). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

status_qualification: The source’s positive potential convention is made explicit.
